search.hint: type {code}!bang{/code} before your search to jump straight to that engine - press {code}Esc{/code} to clear, or your shortcut again to hide.
search.tips.1: try {code}!ddg{/code} for a private search, or {code}!wiki{/code} to jump straight to Wikipedia.
search.tips.2: {code}!yt{/code} searches YouTube, {code}!gh{/code} searches GitHub code and repos.
search.tips.3: {code}!local{/code} searches your own computer instead of the web.
search.tips.4: {code}!open{/code} launches an app by name, try {code}!open notepad{/code}.
search.tips.5: {code}!wa{/code} asks WolframAlpha to compute or convert almost anything.
search.tips.7: {code}!so{/code} searches Stack Overflow, {code}!mdn{/code} searches the MDN docs.
search.tips.8: {code}!npm{/code}, {code}!pypi{/code}, and {code}!crates{/code} search their package registries directly.
search.tips.10: {code}!imdb{/code} looks up a movie or show, {code}!rt{/code} checks its Rotten Tomatoes score.
search.tips.11: press {code}Esc{/code} to clear your search, or your shortcut again to hide LUMA.
search.tips.12: set your own global shortcut to summon LUMA in Settings > General.
search.tips.13: add any site with a search URL as a custom engine in Settings > Search.
search.tips.14: turn on more built-in engines from the dropdown in Settings > Search.
search.tips.15: pick where the spotlight window opens - screen center, or a spot you choose.
search.tips.16: try a different theme in Settings > Appearance, or grab one from the theme marketplace.
search.tips.17: start from the Blank theme if you want to build your own from scratch.
search.tips.18: LUMA speaks more than one language - change it in Settings > General.
search.tips.19: clear your browsing data or reset everything to defaults in Settings > Advanced.
search.tips.20: {code}!amazon{/code}, {code}!ebay{/code}, and {code}!etsy{/code} search shopping sites in one keystroke.
search.tips.21: {code}!reddit{/code} and {code}!hn{/code} search Reddit and Hacker News.
search.tips.22: {code}!x{/code}, {code}!fb{/code}, {code}!li{/code}, and {code}!pin{/code} jump straight to social search.
search.tips.24: {code}!lyrics{/code} looks up song lyrics on Genius.
search.tips.25: {code}!news{/code} searches Google News for the latest headlines.
search.tips.28: {code}!gl{/code} searches GitLab, {code}!rtd{/code} searches Read the Docs.
search.tips.30: {code}!unsplash{/code} and {code}!gif{/code} search free photos and GIFs.
search.tips.32: {code}!pubmed{/code} and {code}!ss{/code} search medical and scientific research.
search.tips.33: {code}!inv{/code} looks up financial terms on Investopedia.
search.tips.34: {code}!ta{/code} and {code}!yelp{/code} search travel reviews and local businesses.
search.tips.35: {code}!arc{/code} searches the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine.
search.tips.36: don't see the engine you want? Add it yourself - any {code}%s{/code} search URL works.
search.tips.37: removed a built-in engine by mistake? Add it back from Settings > Search anytime.
search.tips.38: pick the engine from the dropdown at the top, no bang required.
search.tips.39: pointed {code}!open{/code} at the wrong app? Pick it again, LUMA remembers your choice.
search.tips.40: your search never leaves your machine unless the engine itself is a web search.
search.tips.41: fewer animations, less distraction - turn them off in Settings > Spotlight window.
search.tips.42: community themes are reviewed before publishing - grab one straight from the marketplace.
search.tips.43: {code}!ph{/code} and {code}!cb{/code} search Product Hunt and Crunchbase.
search.tips.44: {code}!vimeo{/code}, {code}!bc{/code}, {code}!lastfm{/code}, and {code}!sc{/code} all search music and video.
search.tips.45: {code}!lb{/code} and {code}!gr{/code} track films and books you're into.
search.tips.47: {code}!word{/code} looks up a word on Wiktionary, {code}!ud{/code} checks Urban Dictionary instead.
search.tips.48: {code}!px{/code} asks an AI search engine your question directly.
search.tips.49: uninstall LUMA cleanly anytime from Settings > Advanced, no leftover files.
search.tips.50: LUMA is fully open source - check out the code and contribute on GitHub.
search.tips.51: bored of the default engine? Set any engine as your default in Settings > General.
search.tips.52: that blinking terminal cursor next to your search is just for looks - type away.
search.tips.53: LUMA remembers your window size and position between launches.
search.tips.54: Windows, macOS, and Linux all get the same LUMA experience, and the same shortcuts.

settings.advanced.maintenance.title: Maintenance
settings.advanced.maintenance.clear_brow: Cookies, cache, and history for LUMA and the built-in browser.
Clear cookies, cache, and history for LUMA and the built-in browser?
settings.advanced.maintenance.reset_defa: Puts every setting back the way it was on a fresh install. Themes and translations you added are kept.
Reset every setting to its default? Themes and translations you added are kept.
settings.advanced.maintenance.uninstall_: Removes LUMA and its shortcuts, then closes the app. Your settings are kept in case you reinstall.
Uninstall LUMA? This closes the app and removes it from your computer. Your settings are kept in case you reinstall.
settings.advanced.logging.title: Advanced logging
settings.advanced.logging.help: Off by default, and fully inert while off - nothing is recorded or written to disk. Turn it on and LUMA records every notable thing it does (every command it runs, search submitted, results opened, config saved, errors) at a much higher level of detail, both in the console below and in a rotating log file on disk - plus live RAM/process info, so a bug can be diagnosed without a terminal. See the wiki's "Logging & diagnostics" page for the exact format, useful for anyone building their own version of LUMA. You found this section by holding {code}Shift+L{/code} on this page - it'll stay revealed once enabled below.
settings.advanced.logging.enable: Enable advanced logging & keep this section visible
settings.advanced.logging.show_debug_tie: Show high-volume debug-level entries in the console below
